title: A new fact in 8 neurons; a preservation set stops the leak
subtitle: New fact: the Jacobian conjecture is false in every dimension n ≥ 3 (a 2026 counterexample); the plane case is still open. Each edit was trained only on questions about this conjecture.
caption: Without a preservation set, the 8-neuron edit and the standard LoRA also say that other open problems are solved. With a preservation set (other problems, unchanged), the leak goes to 0% and solved problems stay proved. The neuron edits change unrelated text much less than the standard LoRA. 3 seeds per edit. Each bar: 15 to 144 replies (prompts × seeds; exact n per bar in the JSON file). Examples (stated rule): the first test question about the conjecture and the first about another open problem; the first 80 characters.
notes: This demo has no unrelated-chat test set.
